content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the ISI Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download ISI Project Linked Research Associate I Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Project Linked Research Associate I: Ph.D. or equivalent degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, or related areas; or M.E./M.Tech. with 3 years of research, teaching, and design and development experience.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Project Linked Research Associate I: Maximum age should not exceed 35 years as on 01 September 2026. Usual relaxation as per rules for SC, ST, OBC, Differently abled, and exceptional candidates.

content_sections.heading: Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Project Linked Research Associate I: ₹58,000/- (Rupees fifty-eight thousand only) plus HRA per the rules of the Institute per month.

content_sections.text: Shortlisting based on resume and qualifications Online/offline interview

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for ISI Project Linked Research Associate I Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 20-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Statistical Institute (ISI) for filling up temporary research positions in Kolkata, West Bengal.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by ISI?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Project-Linked Research Associate-I under the Applied Statistics Unit of the Indian Statistical Institute.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project-Linked Research Associate-I post in this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for ISI Project-Linked Research Associate-I Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email is 20-10-2026. Candidates must ensure their applications reach before this deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted via email to the designated official email addresses along with all required self-attested documents and resume.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required for the Project-Linked Research Associate-I post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Ph.D. or equivalent degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, or related areas, or possess 3 years of research/teaching experience after M.E./M.Tech.

faq.question: Q7. What is the upper age limit for applying?
faq.answer: The age of the candidate should not exceed 35 years as on 01 September 2026. Usual age relaxations apply for reserved categories as per rules.

faq.question: Q8. What is the monthly salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly salary of ₹58,000/- (Rupees fifty-eight thousand only) plus HRA per the rules of the Institute.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for ISI Research Associate-I?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on their resumes and qualifications, followed by an online or offline interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I check the official website of the Indian Statistical Institute?
faq.answer: You can check the official recruitment updates and details on the official website at https://web.isical.ac.in/jobs.
